mechanism: Cobicistat is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase nicotine metabolism inhibition, and nicotine induces CYP1A2 which could theoretically affect cobicistat levels; additionally, both agents can increase cardiovascular stress.
action: Monitor for increased nicotine adverse effects (tachycardia, hypertension, tremor); consider nicotine dose reduction or alternative smoking cessation methods; assess baseline and periodic cardiovascular status.
